POST /v1/distill

Distill Webpage Subtree

Deterministically compiles dirty HTML & CSS rules into token-budgeted Tailwind HTML, JSX, or GFM Markdown in under 5ms.

TypeScript SDK Example

import { grab } from '@anygrab/core';

const result = grab(document.querySelector('main')!, {
  format: 'jsx',
  maxTokens: 1200,
  compactSvg: true,
});
console.log(result.metrics.compressionRatio);

Request Body Parameters

Parameter Type Default Description
format 'prompt' | 'tailwind-html' | 'jsx' | 'markdown' 'prompt' Target serialization format for downstream coding agents.
maxTokens number undefined Token ceiling triggering AST saliency sibling folding.
compactSvg boolean true Collapses verbose vector paths into semantic icon placeholders.

arXiv:2611.00421v1 [cs.SE] Donate to institution banner

§4. Sub-Linear AST Saliency Pruning & Empirical Ablations

Given an input DOM tree T = (V, E) and token budget B, naive character slicing corrupts closing tags and drops bottom-heavy tabular summaries. We instead assign deterministic structural saliency weights w(v) over semantic landmarks.

Theorem 4.1 (Tag-Closed Budget Monotonicity). For any valid DOM subtree T with |V| nodes and budget B ≥ B_min, single-pass post-order sibling folding terminates in O(|V|) time and guarantees 100% balanced HTML/JSX element closure while preserving top-k salient landmarks.
